reading.body:
Involta-Akron sits at 191 E Miller Ave in Akron, Ohio, and operates as Ark Data Centers following a rebrand from Involta. The facility publishes no power capacity figure. It holds Tier III design certification and a 100 percent power delivery SLA, both self-reported, which qualify it to host mission-critical workloads. Ohio has 76 mapped data center facilities, but only eight publish power capacity; this campus publishes none, placing it outside the state's measurable fleet despite being tracked in the registry.

Without published megawatt figures, the campus cannot be positioned against the state's 60.4 MW of disclosed capacity or ranked among facilities reporting power draw. The research note flags that two named facilities, Akron I and Akron II, exist under this single registry row, suggesting the address may cover multiple buildings or a campus layout, but no operational split or power allocation between them is published.

Ark Data Centers' rebrand of the Involta Akron site is recent and verified through the operator's own domain, copyright notice, and independent aggregator listings. The lack of published power capacity limits the site's visibility in capacity-based AI scaling analysis, even if the Tier III certification indicates readiness for demanding workloads. An operator's decision to enter or leave the published-specs disclosure practice would move this campus into or out of the state ranking.
